iso_9001.title: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System (QMS)
iso_9001.introduction: ISO 9001:2015 is the premier international standard for Quality Management Systems (QMS). It establishes standard operating procedures (SOPs), customer satisfaction frameworks, and continuous risk-based quality assurance.
iso_9001.why_required: Mandatory for participating in government tenders, OEM vendor onboarding, corporate vendor registrations, and global export client eligibility.
iso_9001.eligibility: Any manufacturing, engineering, service, IT, construction, or trading organization of any size.
benefits: Globally recognized quality benchmark badge
100% eligibility for Govt Tenders & corporate vendor registration
Drastic reduction in shopfloor errors, customer complaints & re-work
Streamlined SOPs and institutionalized management processes
process: Internal Quality Audit & Management Review Meeting (MRM)
Final Certification Audit by accredited certification body
iso_9001.timeline: 10 to 20 business days with PRV fast-track assistance.

faqs.question: Is ISO 9001 valid internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes, ISO 9001 is recognized and respected in over 170 countries worldwide.

faqs.question: How long is the ISO 9001 certificate valid?
faqs.answer: ISO 9001 certificates are valid for 3 years with mandatory annual surveillance audits.

iso_9001.comparison: ISO 9001 provides general quality management across all industries, whereas IATF 16949 is specialized strictly for automotive supply chains.
iso_9001.prv_approach: PRV Consultancy provides complete end-to-end handholding including SOP drafting, staff training, internal mock audits, and guaranteed 100% audit clearance.
iso_9001.prv_recommended_solution: If your company wants to win corporate/govt tenders or build standardized processes, ISO 9001 is the mandatory baseline certification you should implement immediately.

iso_14001.title: ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management System (EMS)
iso_14001.introduction: ISO 14001:2015 specifies requirements for an environmental management system to enable organizations to enhance environmental performance, fulfill compliance obligations, and achieve environmental objectives.
iso_14001.why_required: Required to satisfy Pollution Board (CPCB/SPCB) regulations, clear international buyer audits, and meet corporate ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) criteria.
iso_14001.eligibility: Manufacturing plants, chemical processors, textiles, automotive, construction, and energy companies.
benefits: Ensures full statutory compliance with Pollution Board norms (CTE/CTO)
Reduces raw material waste, chemical hazards & energy consumption
Significantly boosts corporate ESG ratings for global buyers
Prevents environmental non-compliance fines & legal notices
process: EMS Documentation, Waste SOPs & Operational Controls
Internal Environmental Audit & Emergency Mock Drills
documents_required: Pollution Board NOC (Consent to Establish / Consent to Operate)

faqs.question: Does ISO 14001 help in getting Pollution NOC?
faqs.answer: Yes, Pollution Control Boards favor ISO 14001 certified plants due to their documented waste & environmental management protocols.

iso_14001.comparison: Unlike standard local pollution clearance, ISO 14001 is a proactive, internationally audited system for sustainable manufacturing.
iso_14001.prv_approach: PRV environmental engineers create legal registers, aspect-impact matrices, and train your safety officers for zero-non-conformity audits.
iso_14001.prv_recommended_solution: If your plant handles waste, chemicals, or energy-intensive machinery, implement ISO 14001 alongside ISO 9001 for integrated EHS compliance.

iso_45001.title: ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health & Safety (OH&S)
iso_45001.introduction: ISO 45001:2018 is the global standard for occupational health and safety management systems, designed to protect workers and visitors from work-related accidents and diseases.
iso_45001.why_required: Crucial to satisfy Factory Inspectorate laws, prevent workplace fatalities or injuries, lower insurance liabilities, and qualify for heavy industry tenders.
iso_45001.eligibility: Factories, heavy engineering, construction, mining, chemical units, logistics, and infrastructure developers.
benefits: Creates a zero-accident workplace culture
Strict compliance with Indian Factory Act regulations
Lowers insurance premiums and minimizes lost-time injury (LTI) costs
Boosts worker morale and shopfloor productivity
process: OH&S Policy, PPE Mandates & Emergency Response Protocols
Safety Training, First-Aid Setup & Safety Committee meetings
documents_required: Safety Committee Minutes & Medical Checkup Logs
Fire Safety NOC & First Aid Inspectorate Records

faqs.question: Is ISO 45001 mandatory under Factory Act?
faqs.answer: While Factory Act mandates safety norms, ISO 45001 is the international gold standard that guarantees compliance during government inspections.

iso_45001.comparison: ISO 45001 replaced OHSAS 18001, providing a proactive risk-based approach integrated directly into overall business management.
iso_45001.prv_approach: PRV safety experts conduct physical HIRA audits, establish safety committee frameworks, and deliver shopfloor PPE enforcement training.
iso_45001.prv_recommended_solution: Essential for any manufacturing unit with shopfloor machinery or high labor strength to ensure legal safety compliance and zero downtime.

iso_22000.title: ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management System (FSMS)
iso_22000.introduction: ISO 22000:2018 combines HACCP principles with ISO management standards to control food safety hazards (biological, chemical, physical) across the entire food supply chain.
iso_22000.why_required: Required for food exporters, food processors, FMCG suppliers, cold storage operators, and large-scale caterers supplying to modern retail or international markets.
iso_22000.eligibility: Food manufacturers, agricultural exporters, beverage plants, packaging suppliers, and commercial kitchens.
benefits: Comprehensive food safety control from raw material to consumption
Mandatory requirement for international food export contracts
Prevents costly food recalls, contamination incidents & brand damage
Seamless alignment with FSSAI Central Licensing & FoSTaC standards
process: HACCP Plan & Critical Control Point (CCP) identification
Sanitation, Pest Control & Water Quality SOP enforcement
documents_required: Water Potability Test Reports & Pest Control Logs
Employee Medical Fitness & Hygiene SOP Certificates

faqs.question: Is ISO 22000 mandatory if I already have FSSAI?
faqs.answer: FSSAI is a mandatory statutory Indian license. ISO 22000 is an international management standard necessary for exports and Tier-1 brand supply.

iso_22000.comparison: FSSAI is domestic law; ISO 22000 is international export capability.
iso_22000.prv_approach: PRV food safety technologists build customized HACCP plans, perform hygiene audits, and guarantee certification clearance.
iso_22000.prv_recommended_solution: If you process, package, or export food items, pair your FSSAI License with ISO 22000 to win global retail buyers.

iso_27001.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management System (ISMS)
iso_27001.introduction: ISO 27001:2022 is the international gold standard for data security, cybersecurity, privacy protection, and risk management across digital assets.
iso_27001.why_required: Essential for IT companies, SaaS platforms, BPOs, fintech, healthcare, and software developers serving US/European clients or handling sensitive data.
iso_27001.eligibility: IT services, SaaS platforms, cloud providers, fintech, BPO/KPO, healthcare IT, and financial institutions.
benefits: Guarantees protection against cyberattacks, data breaches & ransomware
Mandatory requirement for US, EU & global IT client contracts
Fulfills India DPDP Act 2023, GDPR, and SOC 2 security compliance
Builds unshakeable enterprise client trust and competitive edge
process: Information Security Risk Assessment & Asset Inventory
Statement of Applicability (SoA) creation across 93 Annex A controls
Security Policies, Access Control & VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment)
documents_required: Network Diagrams, Access Logs & VAPT Scan Reports

faqs.question: How does ISO 27001 help in SaaS client onboarding?
faqs.answer: Enterprise software buyers in US/EU mandate ISO 27001 before signing vendor contracts or passing security risk reviews.

iso_27001.comparison: ISO 27001 sets overall information security management systems, while SOC 2 evaluates operational security controls specifically for US SaaS buyers.
iso_27001.prv_approach: PRV cybersecurity consultants conduct VAPT audits, draft SoA matrices, configure security controls, and lead audit defense.
iso_27001.prv_recommended_solution: If you operate in IT, SaaS, or software services, ISO 27001:2022 is mandatory to unlock international enterprise deals.

iso_22301.title: ISO 22301:2019 Business Continuity Management System (BCMS)
iso_22301.introduction: ISO 22301:2019 helps organizations prepare for, respond to, and recover from unexpected operational disruptions such as natural disasters, cyberattacks, power failures, or supply chain breakdowns.
iso_22301.why_required: Critical for mission-critical businesses to demonstrate disaster readiness to clients and regulatory authorities.
iso_22301.eligibility: Banks, financial institutions, IT data centers, hospitals, critical logistics, and continuous process manufacturing.
benefits: Ensures zero operational breakdown during crises or outages
Protects enterprise revenue, client trust, and brand reputation
Gives high confidence to investors and corporate enterprise clients
documents_required: Disaster Recovery Plan & Testing Drill Logs

faqs.question: Who requires ISO 22301?
faqs.answer: Financial sector entities, data centers, and enterprise vendors who cannot afford even 1 hour of operational downtime.

iso_22301.comparison: ISO 22301 focuses on operational recovery during emergencies, complementing ISO 27001 data security.
iso_22301.prv_approach: PRV consultants formulate Business Impact Analysis, structure BCP recovery procedures, and oversee disaster recovery testing.
iso_22301.prv_recommended_solution: Recommended for IT centers, financial hubs, and infrastructure enterprises seeking high-tier resilience assurance.

iso_50001.title: ISO 50001:2018 Energy Management System (EnMS)
iso_50001.introduction: ISO 50001:2018 provides a framework to establish, implement, maintain, and improve an energy management system, enabling organizations to systematically achieve continual improvement of energy performance.
iso_50001.why_required: Crucial for energy-intensive factories seeking to slash utility costs, lower carbon footprints, and satisfy BEE (Bureau of Energy Efficiency) PAT mandates.
iso_50001.eligibility: Steel plants, cement, textiles, paper mills, chemical plants, thermal power, automotive foundries.

Demonstrates active carbon footprint & greenhouse gas reduction
Fulfills BEE PAT scheme compliance for designated energy consumers
documents_required: Energy Review Report & Utility Bill History

iso_50001.comparison: ISO 14001 focuses on waste and environmental protection, while ISO 50001 focuses strictly on energy efficiency and cost reduction.
iso_50001.prv_approach: PRV energy consultants analyze baseline consumption, design EnPI metrics, and deliver measurable energy cost savings.
iso_50001.prv_recommended_solution: If monthly industrial energy bills exceed ₹5 Lakhs, implement ISO 50001 to unlock massive bottom-line savings.

iatf.eligibility: Automotive component manufacturers, stamping, plastic injection molding, casting, forging, wire harness, and machining units.

Practical shopfloor elimination of rejections, scrap & warranty claims

fssai.introduction: FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India) is the mandatory statutory licensing authority under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India.

fssai.eligibility: Food manufacturers, restaurants, food packaging plants, cloud kitchens, importers/exporters, and distributors.

Ensures consumer safety and protection against food inspectorate fines
